messages:
emily_marketing: Heads-up 101: we're launching a microtest on the pricing page tomorrow AM. Variants: A) FAQ reorder + 'Starter/Scale' tier naming + simple estimator, B) FAQ reorder + 'Launch/Scale' naming + estimator with regional monthly/meters toggle. Aim: reduce trial form abandonment and increase webinar signups for the next benchmark webinar. Need: hero post copy, webinar CTA, and SDR routing rules.

alex_growth: For hero I'll propose a short line: 'Predictably low inference costs, built for scaling apps.' Will attach 2 alt CTAs: 'Estimate your bill' and 'See benchmarks'.

nora_content: Can we test microcopy on the calculator button too? i.e., 'Estimate monthly cost' vs 'Get instant estimate' - different perceived immediacy.

sam_sales: Important: when estimate >= $1,200/mo or predicted tokens > 100k, surface a 'Book a walkthrough' CTA and tag the lead `pricing_est_high`. Also request that the calculator records referrer and traffic cohort (A/B label).

tamika_cs: We'll add a tooltip in the calculator explaining what "metered" means for token pricing. CS will draft short FAQ snippet . Also want a subtle PS on the calculator that says "Enterprise plans available" for high estimates.

mona_prod: I'll update the CMS to reorder the FAQ blocks (billing/security first) and add data attributes for `data-experiment=pricing_microsite_v2`. Technical answers will be collapsed under "Developer notes" as discussed.

emily_marketing: Great. Sam can you confirm Intercom flow? Need assignment and an initial slack notification to AEs.

sam_sales: Confirmed. Intercom rule: when tag `pricing_est_high` or form selects 'Schedule a demo', create a conversation, set company size if provided, and push notification to #sales-leads-inbound. If account seats > 50, escalate to senior AE.

devops-bot: Note: feature-flag `pricing_experiment_v12` scheduled ON at 2026-04-06T08:45:00Z. Rolling deploy across regions; EU variant forcing calculator B.

emily_marketing: I'll draft the hero + 2 CTAs and the webinar invite. Nora, can you prepare the 3 microcopy permutations for the calculator button? Mona, please coordinate a one-hour blackout window for CMS push.

nora_content: On it  will share copy by 14:00.

mona_prod: CMS push scheduled 08:30-09:00 UTC; will coordinate with devops for toggle time.

emily_marketing: One more ask: Alex, include a tiny benchmark blurb (p95 latency + cost/1k tokens) for the webinar landing, we can expand in the benchmark narrative. Keep it short.

alex_growth: Yep  will attach a 2-sentence takeaway and link to the internal benchmark doc.

emily_marketing: Perfect. We'll monitor trial start -> form submit -> demo conversion funnel in Amplitude and update after 48h. Ping here for any blockers. :rocket:
